initial_regression.reason: Two old assertions required chat reads not to publish state. Replaced with actual unchanged-content and durable-chat assertions; corrected the first assertion fixture.

limitations: 256 retained turns per profile; immutable objects retained; no retention compactor or browser history UI.
Store reopen tested; no power-loss certification. Existing single-writer lock needs verified operator recovery after a crash.
Schema upgrade is not readable by old binaries; preserve new data and use an existing compatible snapshot for rollback.
